NGA.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
VoiceAgent is offered to agencies; no government body is said to use it.
mDoc and Extension Africa are private ventures; no public sector system is said to use AI.

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that awarri is developing AI models supporting Igbo, Yoruba, Hausa and Nigerian Pidgin, for translation and transcription.

NGA.note: Gates Foundation funding of a hub is not a state startup law or public fund.

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that the Nigeria AI Scaling Hub, hosted by Lagos Business School and backed by up to $7.5 million from the Gates Foundation over three years, showcased five ventures at Moonshot 2026; no cohort programme is described.
